name: 咚漫（简体中文官方公开网页）

provenance.implementation: Independent public HTML adapter, reusing Triomi WEBTOON parsing conventions but with a distinct source ID, exact host validation, native Chinese search route and chapter restrictions. No upstream code or images copied.
provenance.scope: Public Simplified Chinese web episodes only. Paid, login/age gated and app-only chapters are not bypassed. Public chapter-list pagination is exhaustive; numbering gaps are official restrictions, not fabricated entries. No webtoons.com host rewriting.
provenance.networkEvidence: 2026-10-29: calendar/search, distinct search pages, episodeList canonical redirect, both chapter-list pages, 112-image viewer and JPEG bytes reachable. Evidence: release_ios/chinese-ports/dongmanmanhua-probe.json.
